description: Hi everyone! 👋 I'm passionate about space exploration, NASA missions, science, and technology. I enjoy learning new skills, exploring creative ideas, and solving real-world problems. I'm looking for enthusiastic teammates skilled in Python, web development, data analysis, UI/UX design, research, or presentation. Beginners are welcome too! Let's share ideas, collaborate, learn together, and build something innovative for NASA Space Apps Challenge! 🚀
